content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the NIH Roorkee Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: NIH Roorkee Project Scientist-I Vacancy Details 2026
Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: PhD Degree in Science or in Engg. from a recognized University or equivalent in Hydrology/Hydrogeology/ Geo-informatics/ Water Resources/ Remote Sensing and GIS/ Civil Engineering/Geophysics with numerical modelling knowledge.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 35 years Age Relaxation: 5 years for SC/ST/OBC/Women and physically handicapped candidates.

content_sections.heading: NIH Roorkee Project Scientist-I Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the Project Scientist-I post at NIH Roorkee?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Project Scientist-I post at NIH Roorkee is scheduled for 14th August 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Scientist-I position?
faq.answer: The required qualification is a PhD Degree in Science or Engineering from a recognized university in fields like Hydrology, Hydrogeology, Geo-informatics, Water Resources, Remote Sensing and GIS, Civil Engineering, or Geophysics, with knowledge of numerical modeling.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Project Scientist-I role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 56,000 per month, plus HRA as applicable.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for applying to this post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Scientist-I post is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for certain categories.

faq.question: Q6. Are there any age relaxations provided?
faq.answer: Yes, an age relaxation of 5 years is provided for candidates belonging to SC/ST, OBC, Women, and physically handicapped categories.

faq.question: Q7. How many vacancies are available for the Project Scientist-I post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Scientist-I position at the National Institute of Hydrology, Roorkee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment will be based on a Walk-in-Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies of educational certificates, ID proof, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable), along with recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in interview going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the National Institute of Hydrology (NIH Roorkee), Roorkee, Uttarakhand, Pin code: 247667.
